components.name: button
components.description: The Button component: one component, styled by VARIANT × SIZE, with disabled and loading states.

components.name: button-group
components.description: AttachedEdges marks the sides of a control that sit flush against a neighbor — those corners render square and the shared border collapses.

components.name: badge
components.description: BadgeVariant selects how the badge's scheme paints it.

components.name: card
components.description: CardVariant selects the card chrome.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: Checkbox is the checkbox: a rounded box with a check mark when on, a label beside it.

components.name: code-block
components.description: CodeSpan is one styled run inside a CodeBlock line — typically a highlighter token.

components.name: switch
components.description: Switch is the toggle: a rounded track with a sliding thumb, accent-colored when on, animated on the app's shared clock.

components.name: input
components.description: InputVariant selects the field chrome.

components.name: item
components.description: Item is shadcn's list-row primitive: a flex container for media, title, description and actions.

components.name: kbd
components.description: Kbd renders a keyboard-key hint — a small bordered cap in muted ink: the "⌘K" beside a search field.

components.name: input-otp
components.description: InputOTP is the one-time-code input: character slots rendered as attached boxes driven by ONE hidden editor — click anywhere on the row, type or paste, and the code fills left to right.

components.name: field
components.description: Field is the form-field wrapper: label, helper text, error message and required marker around ANY control — an Input, a Dropdown, a Checkbox group, your own widget.

components.name: select
components.description: Select is the select control: a bordered trigger showing the current choice with a chevron; clicking it opens a FLOATING panel of options over the content beneath (the shared portal primitive), with the selected row check-marked.

components.name: tabs
components.description: TabsVariant selects the tab look.

components.name: dialog
components.description: Dialog is the one overlay primitive, modeled on Chakra-UI's Dialog : a dimmed scrim over the ENTIRE window with a width-capped SurfaceCard centered on it.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.description: The DropdownMenu family: a panel of actions.

components.name: example
components.description: Example is Preview|Code chrome: one bordered rounded card whose tab strip is the top of the card (surface2), not a free-floating Tabs well.

components.name: accordion
components.description: Accordion is the vertically stacked disclosure: titles that expand one panel of content at a time (set Multiple for independent panels).

components.name: alert
components.description: AlertVariant selects the alert's role.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.description: AlertDialog is the interruption that requires a decision: a Dialog that absorbs every outside click and Escape (no backdrop dismissal, no corner ✕) and offers exactly Cancel and Action.

components.name: avatar
components.description: AvatarProps are the avatar's options.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.description: Breadcrumb renders the path to the current page: muted ancestor labels separated by chevrons, the LAST label in full ink as the current page.

components.name: pagination
components.description: Pagination is the page selector: previous/next plus numbered pages, long ranges elided around the current page.

components.name: popover
components.description: Popover is the anchored floating panel for arbitrary content — the general form of Select's dropdown, built on the same portal primitive.

components.name: hover-card
components.description: HoverCard is the hover-preview panel: rest the pointer on a trigger and a content card floats in on the portal layer — for sighted users to preview what's behind a link (shadcn Hover Card).

components.name: annotated-text
components.description: GlossaryTerm is one in-text term with a HoverCard tip.

components.name: progress
components.description: Progress renders a determinate progress bar: a track in the subtle fill, the filled portion in the brand solid.

components.name: radio-group
components.description: RadioOption is one radio choice — the choice contract lives with SelectOption; Description renders muted under the label and Disabled makes this one option unclickable (both replacing the index-aligned slices RadioGroup used to carry).

components.name: separator
components.description: Separator is the semantic divider: a 1dp hairline in the theme's subtle border ink, horizontal by default.

components.name: skeleton
components.description: Skeleton is the loading placeholder: a rounded block pulsing gently between the theme's subtle fills on the shared clock.

components.name: slider
components.description: Slider is the draggable value control: a track, the filled range in the brand solid, a round thumb.

components.name: spinner
components.description: Spinner is the standalone loading indicator: the same three-quarter arc Button's loading state draws, rotating on the frame clock, in the theme's muted ink (pass a Scheme'd color via SpinnerTint for anything else).

components.name: table
components.description: TableProps are the table's options.

components.name: textarea
components.description: Textarea is the multi-line sibling of Input: the same frame chrome and size presets, a wrapping editor inside, with a minimum height in rows.

components.name: toast
components.description: ToastVariant selects the toast's role.

components.name: toggle
components.description: Toggle is the pressed-state button: an icon or label that stays filled while On.

components.name: tooltip
components.description: Tooltip attaches a hover label to any widget: hold the pointer over the child for a beat and the label floats in beneath it, inverted chrome (dark surface, light ink).

components.name: grid
components.description: Grid is the 2D layout primitive: equal-width tracks (repeat(N, 1fr) in web terms), items auto-flowing row-major, each optionally spanning columns and rows.

components.name: listview
components.description: The list family — a lotusui extension: Scrollable (whole-content scrolling for a screen's mixed content), ListView (its VIRTUALIZED sibling for long, uniform collections) and HoverRow (the one way a list row reads as interactive).

components.name: scroll-area
components.description: ScrollArea is shadcn Scroll Area — whole-content scrolling inside a bounded viewport WITHOUT layout.List's op.Record macros, with a

components.name: split
components.description: Split arranges a screen's main panes as a CAROUSEL.

components.name: stack
components.description: Stack lays out children along one axis with a uniform gap between them — Chakra UI's Stack, as a Gio widget.

blocks.name: login-form
blocks.description: Package login is the login-form block: a ready-made composition of Card, Field, Input and Button — vendor it with `lotusui add login-form` and shape it to your app.
